meta.title: Kisumu County: budget, exchequer, expenditure and absorption by department, FY 2021/22 to 2024/25 (held; not on pages)
meta.unit: KSh million; *_pct columns in per cent as printed
meta.rule: One record per department row of the Controller of Budget table, cells as printed. Every cell was read by Claude from the rendered page image (the publisher text layer is OCR with errors and was not used for values). "-" printed is kept as null with status "dash", never zero. Department names and groupings change between years and are kept as printed; no row is mapped across years. Ratios are the report's own; checks recompute them from the printed amounts but never replace them. 2024/25 prints a revised budget and whole-number percentages. Every value is provisional until a reviewer approves it.
